Demand

What the transmission system sees, and what the country actually used.

Under development

This page is not built yet. It will carry both demand figures and the arithmetic between them — national demand is a meter reading, underlying demand adds a modelled estimate of embedded generation, and the two answer different questions.

The figures it will carry are already live on the dashboard, and how each one is derived is set out on the Methodology page.

Data it will be built on: Elexon INDO / ITSDO demand outturn and Sheffield Solar PV_Live.
